{{Quote|How are you planning to use it?''"<br />"''With a flechette cartridge. Let's see her try a lightwhip on that.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>}}
A '''flechette launcher''' was an anti-personnel weapon that saw extensive use during the last half of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. This weapon fired canisters containing hundreds of razor-sharp [[Flechette/Legends|flechettes]] &mdash; [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] darts that spread out over the large area. The projectiles would explode, releasing flechettes at high velocity in a wide spread.

A single antipersonnel canister could eliminate an entire squad of soldiers, while anti-vehicle rounds, consisting of eleven-centimeter-long missiles, could affect a concentrated area of five meters in diameter. The flechettes contained within were strong enough to rip through ten centimeters of durasteel, and were effective countermeasures against [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and other light [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]].

Flechette launchers could also be wrist-mounted. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mahwi Lihnn]] wore a palm flechette shooter.
